title: Factory preset XML assets (Tight Lead, Wide Lead, Huge Solo, Mono-Safe Subtle, Live Tracking)
description:
Create the five factory APVTS XML preset assets under Resources/Presets/ only. These are BinaryData inputs for e.2 and regression fixtures per Build Spec §12.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §12 (factory bank values) and §5 (stable parameter IDs)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h (detuneAmount, delayL, delayR, monoXover, width, mix, latencyMode, outTrim, bypass, monoSource)
- Source/StateManager.* and PluginProcessor get/setStateInformation XML/ValueTree shape (parameterLayoutVersion / schema property names)
- Sibling factory preset XML under /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/ if present (APVTS VALUE_TREE / PARAM id/value conventions)

Implement five files (exact names for BinaryData/CMake later):
1. Resources/Presets/TightLead.xml — Detune ±5 (detuneAmount=5), delayL=10, delayR=14, monoXover=200, width=90, mix=30; latencyMode=Studio; outTrim=0; bypass=0; monoSource=Sum (defaults where unspecified).
2. Resources/Presets/WideLead.xml — detuneAmount=7, delayL=12.5, delayR=18, monoXover=180, width=100, mix=40; Studio; outTrim=0; bypass=0; monoSource=Sum.
3. Resources/Presets/HugeSolo.xml — detuneAmount=14, delayL=20, delayR=28, monoXover=150, width=140, mix=55; Studio; outTrim=0; bypass=0; monoSource=Sum.
4. Resources/Presets/MonoSafeSubtle.xml — detuneAmount=4, delayL=8, delayR=11, monoXover=250, width=70, mix=25; Studio; outTrim=0; bypass=0; monoSource=Sum.
5. Resources/Presets/LiveTracking.xml — latencyMode=Live, detuneAmount=6, delayL=10, delayR=13, monoXover=200, width=90, mix=35; outTrim=0; bypass=0; monoSource=Sum.

XML requirements:
- Valid well-formed XML loadable as a juce::ValueTree / APVTS state fragment (or full state tree consistent with StateManager restore).
- Parameter IDs must match ParameterIDs.h strings exactly (never invent dual detune IDs; one detuneAmount applied as ± later).
- Include layout/schema version property matching parameterLayoutVersion/schemaVersion = 1 so StateManager accepts the tree.
- Human-readable preset name may appear as a tree property or filename-derived label; keep content deterministic and free of host-specific absolute paths.
- Do not embed BinaryData or edit CMakeLists (e.2 sole owner).

Wave 1 independent of e.3–e.5.
acceptance_criteria: Resources/Presets/TightLead.xml exists with detuneAmount=5, delayL=10, delayR=14, monoXover=200, width=90, mix=30
Resources/Presets/WideLead.xml exists with detuneAmount=7, delayL=12.5, delayR=18, monoXover=180, width=100, mix=40
Resources/Presets/HugeSolo.xml exists with detuneAmount=14, delayL=20, delayR=28, monoXover=150, width=140, mix=55
Resources/Presets/MonoSafeSubtle.xml exists with detuneAmount=4, delayL=8, delayR=11, monoXover=250, width=70, mix=25
Resources/Presets/LiveTracking.xml exists with latencyMode=Live, detuneAmount=6, delayL=10, delayR=13, monoXover=200, width=90, mix=35
Each preset XML is well-formed and uses ParameterIDs.h string IDs plus layout/schema version 1
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add juce_add_binary_data or BinaryData generation here (e.2)
invent dual detune parameter IDs or renumber ParameterIDs

allowed: APVTS/ValueTree XML shape matching StateManager restore
encode choice params as index or choice text consistent with existing APVTS
optional display-name property on the tree
forbidden: add extra preset files beyond the five named assets
